§ 1.1402(a)-1. Definition of net earnings from self-employment. This section provides that net
earnings from self-employment means the gross income derived by an individual from any trade or
business carried on by such individual, less allowable deductions attributable to that trade or
business, plus the individual's distributive share of income or loss from a partnership carrying
on a trade or business, computed consistent with 26 U.S.C. § 1402.
